exhibition_evidence: Global masterplanning firm (Dubai/London/Shanghai/Singapore offices); no exhibition space identified for this project.
address: Dubai, UAE (regional office) / London, Nottinghamshire, Mumbai, Shanghai, Singapore
key_messages: Vision for a 'new twin capital' east of Tashkent between the Chirchiq and Karasu rivers
First phase includes Airport City, Trade District, CBD and 300-hectare Administrative District
Masterplan approved by the President of Uzbekistan and Mayor of Tashkent at high level
raw_notes: Described project scale as 200,000,000 sqm on 20,000 hectares. Appears to be an earlier pre-concept stage, later superseded/complemented by Cross Works' more detailed District 1 masterplan.

name: AL-BINA Development
project_role: Developer / strategic partner (sales, marketing, positioning) for Crystal Avenue, a premium/business-class residential complex in New Tashkent District 1, in partnership with UET Construction and IMAN Holding; also partners with BI Group and NRG on other Tashkent-area projects.
exhibition_evidence: Central sales office ('Центральный офис продаж AL-BINA') at ЖК U-Tower, Tashkent, plus a dedicated Crystal Avenue sales office in New Tashkent.
address: Central sales office: ЖК U-Tower, Tashkent; project sales office: Crystal Avenue, New Tashkent
key_messages: Crystal Avenue positioned as 'the main avenue of the new capital' / 'smart luxury'
Strategic partnership with IMAN Holding announced for flexible payment/investment products
Sales for Crystal Avenue launched 6 December 2025
price_signal: Premium / business-class positioning (no published price list found)
raw_notes: Crystal Avenue located in District 1, New Tashkent's key growth cluster; described as AL-BINA's/UET's first business-class project in New Tashkent. AL-BINA's wider Tashkent portfolio (Maftun Makon, Flagman, 4U Tashkent with NRG-BI) appears located in a separate 'New Uzbekistan' district near Yashnabad/Olympic town, not confirmed as part of New Tashkent.

name: UET Construction
typology_detail: Contractor + Developer (EPC/construction company acting as co-developer)
project_role: General contractor and project originator for Crystal Avenue, a premium residential complex in New Tashkent District 1, in partnership with AL-BINA Development (sales/marketing) and IMAN Holding.
exhibition_evidence: Shares the Crystal Avenue project sales office in New Tashkent with AL-BINA; formal project presentation event held on-site at the New Tashkent Directorate (29 Nov 2025).
address: Crystal Avenue sales office, New Tashkent, Tashkent
key_messages: Officially entered residential/commercial real estate with Crystal Avenue as its flagship project
Self-describes as a fast-growing engineering & construction (EPC) company
Crystal Avenue unveiled as 'a premium residential complex in New Tashkent'
raw_notes: Company site (uetconstruction.com) frames itself around 'Integrated EPC solutions for energy and...' sectors, with Crystal Avenue as its entry into residential development in New Tashkent.

name: BI Group
typology_detail: Developer + Contractor (integrated development, engineering, construction group)
project_role: Began construction of the 'Astana' residential district directly within New Tashkent; first phase covers a 10-hectare site valued at ~$200M, with roughly 3,000 apartments planned. Also active in Tashkent more broadly (NRG-BI joint brand, Botanika Saroyi, Oybek).
exhibition_evidence: Large regional developer with sales offices across Tashkent (via NRG-BI brand); no showroom specifically confirmed for the New Tashkent 'Astana' site yet (early construction phase).
key_messages: 'BI Group Begins Construction of the Astana District in New Tashkent'
First phase: 10-hectare site, project value ~$200 million
Self-described as the '#1 Developer in Central Asia'
raw_notes: ~3,000 apartments planned for the 'Astana' district in New Tashkent per YouTube coverage of the construction launch. Distinct from BI Group/NRG's Maftun Makon and Flagman projects, which appear to sit in a separate area near the Olympic town/New Uzbekistan district, not confirmed as New Tashkent.

name: Sharq Bahori
project_role: Developer of the 'Sharq Bahori' smart-home residential project (two phases: Sharq Bahori 1 and 2) located directly within New Tashkent; professional building management to be handled by the New Tashkent Construction Directorate itself, and the project is featured with its own logo in the Directorate's official site header.
exhibition_evidence: Has a 'sale office' in New Tashkent per its website contact section, but no explicit showroom/model-apartment confirmed in sources reviewed.
materials_brands_mentioned: Laminate parquet; ceramic finishes; German-standard windows and joinery; triple-layer XPS insulation
key_messages: 'The future lives here' - modern & smart residences in New Tashkent
Positioned as a '15-minute city' within New Tashkent, 100m from a metro station
Smart home system (Zigbee protocol), face-ID entry, license-plate recognition parking
raw_notes: Community amenities listed relative to New Tashkent landmarks: Ministry buildings 700m, National Library 1.5km, New Business District 3km, New Tashkent Airport 8.4km. Featured prominently (own logo) in the header of the official newtashkent.uz Directorate website, suggesting a flagship/showcase status.
